major_concerns: Simulator-to-production external validity may bias operational conclusions
Design labels every rejected proposal as a failure (no human repair) which may misrepresent realistic operator workflows
Risk of verifier bugs biasing results if not unit-tested
Prompt/template sensitivity and verifier strictness thresholds not fully specified
required_design_repairs: Add deterministic unit and integration tests for the correctness checker; publish checker code and test vectors
Preregister verifier strictness thresholds and include sensitivity analysis in plan
Record rejected proposals but also log (separately) hypothetical human-repair pathways and their costs (do not use as primary outcome)
Include prompt-variation robustness checks or document prompt fixed seed choices and justify

major_concerns: Synthetic workload may not reflect real production burstiness or multi-tenant effects
Timeout/retry policies can materially bias latency and SLA-miss measurements if underspecified
Benchmark host resource isolation not described; host exhaustion could confound tail-latency
required_design_repairs: Preregister exact timeout and retry policies and justify choices
Provision and document isolated benchmarking environment (resource quotas, monitoring) to avoid host-induced artifacts
Include at least one workload variant that mimics burstiness and a multi-tenant scenario or justify exclusion
Provide baseline microbenchmarks (validator-only, LLM-only) and system-level instrumentation traces

major_concerns: Ethical risk from creating realistic poisoned artifacts—need containment and clear safe-handling
Risk of tuning defenses on test data (overstating defense effectiveness)
Retrieval-system parameter choices (k, scorer) can strongly modulate effect sizes and must be preregistered
required_design_repairs: Constrain poisons to synthetic, non-public corpora and document containment/retention policies
Preregister retrieval system architecture and all hyperparameters (k, retriever model, scoring) and use held-out tuning partitions
Specify and preregister poison-generation protocol and realistic threat model bounds
Log provenance metadata and provide reproducible poison-seeding scripts

major_concerns: Human-subject variability and reviewer expertise differences threaten internal validity and reproducibility
Ethics/IRB procedures, consent, and participant safeguards are underspecified
Use of crowdworker proxies may not generalize to production operators; screening/training details missing
Potential participant stress from time-pressure conditions
required_design_repairs: Obtain and document IRB/ethics approval and include consent/debrief procedures
Preregister reviewer screening, qualification tests, and training protocol; include calibration/pilot run data
Define sample size and power analysis; preregister mixed-effects model specification and randomization scheme
Include opt-out, adequate compensation, and stress-mitigation/debrief procedures
